About this Peg

Italian food & wood-fired pizza in Delray Beach

Connecticut pizza, Florida sunshine. Delray Beach has its own kitchen making dough and sauce from scratch, the same way East Hartford does for our Connecticut Pegs. On West Atlantic Avenue, our Delray Peg feeds snowbirds who missed their Glastonbury pie and locals who are just finding out what the fuss is about.

Every pie starts with dough made fresh daily and never frozen. Choose a red or white Neo-Neapolitan round or a crispy-edged Detroit-style pie, build your own, or go gluten-free with our 12″ crust. Vegan cheese is available on any pizza.

Not in a pizza mood? The kitchen turns out Italian-American comfort food too: chicken parmesan, pasta alla vodka, pasta bolognese, shrimp scampi, spaghetti & meatballs, eggplant parm, chicken and meatball parm sandwiches, salads, wood-fired wings and a kids’ menu. Pair it with a cocktail, a glass of wine or a cold beer.

Good to know

Delray Beach FAQ

What are Square Peg Delray Beach’s hours?

Mon–Thu 11:30am–9pm; Fri 11:30am–10pm; Sat 11am–10pm; Sun 11am–9pm. Holiday hours may vary; online ordering always shows live availability.

Is Square Peg Delray Beach an Italian restaurant?

Yes. Along with wood-fired pizza, Square Peg Delray Beach serves Italian-American favorites like chicken parmesan, pasta alla vodka, pasta bolognese and shrimp scampi, plus chicken and meatball parm sandwiches, salads, wood-fired wings and desserts.

Is Square Peg Delray Beach a good restaurant for families?

Yes. There’s a kids’ menu (pasta, spaghetti and meatballs, chicken fingers, mac and cheese), room for big groups, and large party reservations for birthdays and team dinners.

Does Square Peg Delray Beach serve beer, wine and cocktails?

Yes. Square Peg Delray Beach serves beer, wine and cocktails with dine-in meals, so it works for date nights, game nights and dinner with friends.

Can I order online from Square Peg Delray Beach?

Yes. Tap “Order Delray Beach online” to order for pickup, or choose delivery at checkout where it’s available.

Do you have gluten-free or vegan options?

Yes. We offer a 12″ gluten-free crust, and vegan cheese can be added to any pizza.

Does Square Peg Delray Beach do catering?

Yes. Delray Beach caters birthdays, office lunches, team events and more. Send a quick request on our catering page, or call (561) 566-8828.

Is Square Peg Delray Beach close to Boynton Beach and Boca Raton?

Yes. Square Peg Delray Beach at 4957 W Atlantic Ave in Delray Beach is a short drive from Boynton Beach, Boca Raton, Lake Worth Beach and Highland Beach. Order ahead online for pickup, or check delivery availability at checkout.

Can our group host a fundraiser here?

Yes. Every Tuesday from 4pm to close, one organization earns 20% of dine-in food sales from its supporters.
